notes.title: Update 1.0i
notes.notes:
⚖️ BALANCE CHANGES

 Greataxe skill is now doing damage based on unused capacity on given die => +1 damage per unused capacity.
 Decay skill is now inflicting Weak and Vulnerable based on unused capacity on given die => +1 Weak and +1 Vulnerable per 3 unused capacity.


✨ IMPROVEMENTS

 Modifiers selection is now persistent between runs.
 Descriptions of Feather, Thunderstorm and Chain Lightning updated to more reflect skills and relic effects.
 Whetstone description updated to reflect, that Whetstone does not work with ultimate skill.
 Jumping via Portal now shows quick teleport loading screen.


🛠️ FIXES

 Unstable Energy in upgraded version is fixed.
 Issue with possible Bratwurst abuse when visiting Merchant is fixed.
 Multiple bugs in all translations are fixed.
 Dialogues in Russian language are fixed.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0j
notes.notes:
✨ IMPROVEMENTS

 Borderless fullscreen is now default setting, you can now move freely mouse cursor outside of the game screen.


🛠️ FIXES

 Order of floating text when enemy dies is fixed.
 Corrupted files are now fixed automatically on game start.*
 Russian translation adjusted.

* If you already have corrupted files the fixing process may erase your progress.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0h
notes.notes:
✨ IMPROVEMENTS

 New indicator for Dungeon cleared is displayed on the map.
 Skills, Relics and Enemies in Compendium are sorted in alphabetical order.


🛠️ FIXES

 Highscore issue with unsorted entry at the end of the list is fixed.
 Record in compendium after killing Mimic is correctly updated. 
 Upgrading Curse(s) via Relics is no longer possible.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0g
notes.notes:
✨ IMPROVEMENTS
Multiplier can be viewed in hero selection by hovering over Maelor's Vial.  

Save notification is displayed every time game is saved.  
🛠️ FIXES
 Typos and incorrect translations fixed in Polish.  

Typos and incorrect translations fixed in Czech.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0e & 1.0f
notes.notes:
🛠️ FIXES


 Blood Link description is updated and no longer indicates "Heal" type.
 On-roll skills are now correctly return to the initial position.
 Rewind turn is no longer restarting use count on skills.
 Fixed issue with saving after buying out all items in Merchant event.
 Notification is no longer blocking skill from being dropped. 
 History is now correctly showing traits.
 Fixed a bug where modifiers were being shared between heroes with locked and unlocked Modifiers.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0c & 1.0d
notes.notes:
🛠️ FIXES


 Screen resolution: issue with generating enemies out of dungeon for different screen resolutions is fixed.
 Compendium is now correctly synced with a Steam account.
 Grinding Wheel event now has correct description.
 Visual fix for tutorial in main menu.
 Issue with unlocked characters is resolved and now all unlocked characters should be available in character selection.

notes.title: Publisher Reveal + New Release Date: Launching August 1st
notes.notes:
🎉 We’ve Partnered with a Publisher!

Hey everyone, we’ve got exciting news.

Luck & Loot is officially teaming up with GrabTheGames as our publishing partner.

GrabTheGames has been supporting indie titles on Steam for over a decade. Their experience with visibility, launch strategy, and influencer outreach will be a huge boost as we prepare for release. 

You can check out their work at grabthegames.com. We’ve been handling Luck & Loot as a scrappy, independent team, and this partnership allows us to keep our creative vision intact while giving the game a real shot at reaching a wider audience.

🗓 New Release Date: August 1
To make the most of this opportunity, we’re shifting our release date slightly to August 1. This lines us up with GrabTheGames’ upcoming publisher sale and a larger promotional push. It gives us more visibility and delivers a stronger, more polished launch for everyone.

We know some of you were looking forward to the July 22 release. Thank you so much for your support. The extra time will go toward fine-tuning and getting ready to roll out localization support post-launch, starting in mid-August.

💬 What This Means
Nothing changes about the heart of the game. Luck & Loot is still the same weird, tactical, dice-slinging roguelike you’ve been following. But now we have marketing support, more community reach, and a real shot at making a bigger splash.

You’ll still hear directly from us as development continues. We’re handling all design, story, sound, and updates as always. We’re just better equipped now.

🎲 Wishlist, Share, and Join the Community
The best way to support us right now is by wishlisting on Steam and sharing the game with friends who love dice-builders, eldritch fantasy, or getting completely wrecked by RNG.

Want to hang out, chat with the devs, and meet other players?
Come join our growing Discord community: 

https://discord.gg/xDMpTMXnqd



Thanks again for being part of this with us. 
We’re pumped for August 1 and can’t wait to show you what’s coming next.

— The SMARTcreative team

notes.title: ⚔️ The New Luck & Loot Demo is Here — Full Release on July 22!
notes.notes:
🎲 CLICK TO PLAY THE NEW DEMO 🎲



Try the first 3 dungeons, play as our fearless warrior Tirnaya, and get a real taste of the full game before it drops on July 22.


We’ve rebuilt the demo from the ground up using the final launch content. This isn’t a preview, it’s your invitation to dive into Luck & Loot as it was meant to be played.



🎥 Watch the Gameplay Trailer

[previewyoutube="0ZSKIkspAjE;full"][/previewyoutube]
See the fast-paced dice-building, turn-based combat, and dark fantasy world in motion.



 🔥 What’s in the New Demo?
🧠 Customizable dice with 80+ face combos

💀 30+ skills, 40+ relics, and tons of event variety

📈 Run History

🎨 Improved visuals, color palettes, fonts

🔊 Updated audio design and UI polish

💬 New dialogue and rebalanced bosses

🔄 All the quality-of-life upgrades from the full game

This is a standalone demo, meaning your saves won’t carry over—but it’s the real thing in tone, strategy, and polish.



💡 What is Luck & Loot?


A tactical dice-building roguelike with permadeath, deep strategy, and a haunted realm full of cursed relics, tragic heroes, and corrupted souls. Inspired by Slay the Spire, Darkest Dungeon, and Slice & Dice, but with a darker soul and a pixel-chipped edge.



🚀 Launching July 22 


The full game launches in just one month. If you enjoy the demo:


👉 Wishlist the game to be notified when it releases
👉 Join our Discord to share your runs, ideas, and feedback


Thanks for supporting indie games like this one. We can't wait to show you everything Luck & Loot has in store.



— Team SMARTcreative
